name: Key Vault Secret and Key Destruction
description: Key Vault holds secrets, keys, and certificates. Deleting or changing a vault, a key, or a secret can take applications down or make backups unrestorable — the same idea as deleting a KMS key in AWS. Attackers do this for ransom or to lock operators out of recovery. Soft-delete exists so you can undo some of this; purge is the point of no return. Vault and key deletion should be among the loudest Azure alerts you have.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
